content:
Local rental companies. Clear explanations. Personal help before you book.

Find the right car for your trip

Tell us when and where you need a car, how many people are travelling and how much luggage you have. Idan will check suitable options from Polish rental companies and send you a quotation with the price, deposit and rental conditions.

Request a car hire quote

What you can compare

  • Vehicle categories and representative models.
  • The total quoted rental price and selected extras.
  • Supplier insurance with zero excess, including theft, glass and wheels, subject to the rental conditions.
  • The security deposit, fuel policy and collection arrangements.

A person to help you understand the offer

I am Idan, based in Poland. I work with local rental companies and help customers understand the differences between their offers. You receive the rental company's confirmation after the booking is approved.

How it works

  1. Send your trip details using the quotation form.
  2. Compare the options and ask about anything that is unclear.
  3. Choose an offer and provide the drivers' details.
  4. Receive confirmation and collection instructions.

Submitting the form is a request for a quotation, not a confirmed booking. Prices and availability are checked for your dates. Vehicles are booked by category; a particular model is not guaranteed.

Compare rental companies · Insurance and deposits · Collection, return and travel abroad

Your rental, personally represented

I am Idan, a representative of local rental companies. This is a personal agency service, not an automated price-comparison engine. The form helps us work efficiently; a person stays responsible for coordinating your request and helping you with the company.

My long-standing relationships and volume of bookings make me an important business partner to these companies. Whichever offer you choose, you book as Idan's client and receive my personal VIP service: clear explanations before booking, a named contact and help following up if a problem arises. This service is personal support, rather than a promise of a free upgrade or a change to the supplier's rental conditions.

My approach is straightforward: a clear quoted total, the deposit, selected extras and any relevant conditions explained before you commit. Ask me directly if anything is unclear.

title: Car hire insurance and security deposits
seo_title: Car Hire Insurance & Deposits in Poland | Poland Rent a Car
meta_description: Understand zero-excess car hire insurance, security deposits and driver requirements before booking a rental car in Poland. Ask for a clear quotation.
content:
Supplier insurance with zero excess

Our offers include insurance provided by the rental company with zero excess, including theft, glass and wheels, subject to the rental conditions. This differs from a separate reimbursement policy, where you may first have to pay the rental company and then claim money back from another insurer.

Zero excess does not remove the rental contract's obligations or exclusions. Read the offer and confirmation, and ask about anything that is unclear before accepting.

Why is there still a deposit?

The security deposit is separate from insurance. The amount and release conditions depend on the company and vehicle category. Your offer states the deposit for each option. Insurance does not automatically remove charges for fuel or other obligations under the rental agreement.

Credit card and driver details

Prepare a credit card in the driver's name and tell us about every driver before booking. Give the actual age and length of time each driver has held a licence. Eligibility and any young or newly qualified driver charge depend on the rental company.

Going abroad?

Tell us which countries you plan to visit. Permission and insurance for travel outside the rental country must be checked in advance and may involve an additional charge.

title: Collection, return and driving abroad
seo_title: Car Collection, Return & Travel Abroad | Poland Rent a Car
meta_description: Plan airport or hotel car collection, return in another city and trips outside Poland. Check delivery charges, permission and payment arrangements in advance.
content:
Airport collection and return

Enter the airport, local date and time, and your flight number if known. Collection at a terminal does not necessarily mean that the company has an airport desk. Follow the meeting and return instructions in your confirmation.

Hotel and address delivery

Provide the hotel name and full address. Delivery availability, charges and service hours depend on the company and location. Traffic can affect the representative's arrival time.

Different collection and return locations

Tell us both locations before requesting a quote. Return in another city or country can affect the price and requires confirmation. Arrangements within one city can also have location-specific delivery charges.

Driving outside the rental country

List every country you intend to visit. The company must confirm permission and the relevant insurance conditions. An international collection or return also needs an individual check.

CarFree has a Prague branch. For a rental based in the Czech Republic, cross-border travel means travel outside the Czech Republic. Routes between Prague and Poland need to be assessed separately.

When is payment due?

Payment arrangements are confirmed with the offer. Collection outside Poland may require advance payment. Do not assume that the payment terms for collection in Poland also apply to an international delivery.
